args.message:
Keep the release pin in engine.yaml and name the api-reference hash

The sha256 field in engine.yaml is the release pin that update-engine-pin.py reads. It is restored to b5d10e37, the value before 1542dcb. The api-reference hash moves to api_reference_sha256, which the script does not read. The engine INDEX records both fields.

update-engine-pin.py now matches the sha256 key exactly and refuses to refresh the engine docs unless .jayzee/engine is its own git repository. In this checkout that path resolves to the cleetus repository, so the script would have recorded cleetus HEAD as the engine HEAD.
args.author: lanmower
